name: @gitterm/opencode-plugin
description: Continue OpenCode sessions and local checkout changes in GitTerm cloud workspaces
author: Opeyemi Oginni

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/client --external '@opencode/client/*' && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepack: bun run check-types && bun run build
